title: Prototype Pollution in utils-extend's deep extend
longFix: The recursive `extend` merged source keys with no guard on reserved property names; a `__proto__` key recursed into and polluted Object.prototype. The merge loop now skips `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype`.
summary: `utils-extend`'s deep `extend()` recursively merges a source object into a target. With no guard on reserved keys, a source object parsed from untrusted JSON containing `__proto__` causes the recursion to walk into and mutate `Object.prototype`, polluting every object in the process.
fixExplanation: Source keys naming a prototype slot (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`) are skipped during the recursive merge. All legitimate deep-merge behavior — nested objects, arrays, and the multi-source `extend()` wrapper — is preserved.
